data.standardized_narrative: The report includes a gross claims development table and financial statements, but the scanned images provided are not legible enough to extract a clear gross opening claims outstanding balance or an explicit gross prior-year reserve movement. Gross premiums written for 2017 are visible. No unambiguous gross prior-year movement (release/strengthening) figure could be located in a clearly readable form in the provided pages.
data.data_quality_notes: Scanned PDF pages are low resolution/rotated and many numeric tables are not legible. I could read the total gross premiums written (494,961,091) but could not reliably parse the Statement of Financial Position 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative figure nor the Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding in a clearly unambiguous gross (insurance liabilities) column. A gross claims development triangle is present in the document images but the cell values could not be extracted with confidence. All reserve-related numeric fields are therefore left null. If higher-resolution images or the original PDF text are provided I can extract the required gross reserve numbers and compute prior year development.
